From Kraft Work · Price: touch only, and anything you fix also stops your stand's hand.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: an object your stand touches stops in place (it can't move, even in the air) until you release it as a free action or for 1 minute.
  • 5: Reaction: stop a projectile that would hit you or an adjacent ally (Interact).
  • 9: Surge: a creature your stand hits is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 13: Stopped objects keep stored momentum; release them for @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage.
  • 17: Immobilize for 1 minute on a critical failure.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
